headline: Free Music Classes Reach 21,000 Miami Students Across 131 Schools
meta_description: Young Musicians Unite provides free music education to over 21,000 students in Miami-Dade County, strengthening schools and building community leaders.
summary_short: A nonprofit is transforming education in Miami-Dade County by offering free music classes to 21,000 students across 131 schools, fostering personal growth and community…
body:
Young Musicians Unite (YMU) has quietly become a lifeline for school engagement across Miami-Dade County, providing free music education to more than 21,000 students spread across 131 schools. The nonprofit's mission runs deeper than teaching notes and rhythms: by giving children a reason to show up and a community to belong to, YMU is reshaping how students connect with their schools and futures. As the organization's leadership explains, kids need both a reason to attend school and an opportunity to feel seen—and a music classroom offers exactly that sense of belonging to something larger than themselves.

At Little River K-8, nine-year-old Jayden Morisseau found his answer in the trumpet section. "You get a lot of opportunities to go places, and you get better at playing your horns, and also, you got a good teacher that knows a lot of music," he told CBS News Miami. That teacher is Reinaldo Velez, himself a YMU student who now leads classes at the school. Velez speaks to the transformation music creates: it builds unity, teaches personality skills, and instills practical know-how—from instrument repair to supporting peers in need.

The founder of YMU, a musician himself who grew up in Miami, credits music class with helping him find his voice and develop the skills that led him to lead one of the Southeast's premier music education nonprofits. His journey mirrors the promise embedded in every classroom his organization touches. As one Miami-Dade County commissioner noted, YMU's leaders are invaluable advocates connecting children with the arts and everything those connections mean for their futures. In a county where access to music education might otherwise depend on a family's means, YMU ensures that talent and passion are the only prerequisites.

Nine-year-old Jayden Morisseau leads trumpet section
Free music education spanning personal growth to instrument repair skills
